issue.title: bob ref rename -b <vault> pre-syncs BOB_DIR/~/bob instead of the selected vault

task_type_fields.impact: Anyone running `bob ref rename -b <vault>` against a vault other than `BOB_DIR` (agents in scratch vaults, tests, a second vault) silently syncs and may commit/push the default vault instead, and the selected vault's rename commit is made without the required pre-sync. Tests that pass `-b` without `BOB_DIR` touch the developer's real `~/bob`.
task_type_fields.location: src/native/highlights_ref/rename/plan.rs pre-sync via vault_sync::run_cycle_with_existing_lock_report (syncs bob_env::bob_dir(), not config.bob_dir)
task_type_fields.repro:
`bob ref rename <REF> <NAME> -b /path/to/vault-A` with `BOB_DIR` unset (or pointing at a different vault B):

1. `src/native/highlights_ref/rename/plan.rs` builds `Config::from_matches` (honoring `-b`), takes the maintenance and scan locks and commits in `config.bob_dir` (vault A).
2. Its pre-sync (`rename/plan.rs` ~L268) calls `crate::native::vault_sync::run_cycle_with_existing_lock_report(&child_env, true)`, which syncs `bob_env::bob_dir()` (`src/native/vault_sync.rs` `run_cycle_with_env_report`: `let vault = bob_env::bob_dir();`) — i.e. `BOB_DIR` or `~/bob`, not vault A.

So the pre-sync pulls/commits/pushes the wrong vault (on athena: Bryan's real `~/bob`) and vault A is never synced before the rename commit. The same mechanism made `bob ref create -b <test-vault> -f overwrite` pre-sync `/home/runner/bob` in CI (`pre-sync failed: Bob directory does not exist: /home/runner/bob`, CI run 40351653996, test highlights_create_collection_overwrites_exact_set_with_listen); bob-cli-c9.land fixed only the overwrite path by refusing with `intake_unavailable` when the `-b` vault differs from `BOB_DIR` (reusing intake's `validate_vault_identity`, now exposed as `intake::vault_identity_problem`). Ordinary create intake already queues with `other_vault` in this case.

Fix direction: make rename refuse (or sync the selected vault) when the canonical `-b` vault differs from canonical `BOB_DIR`, with a regression test that sets `-b` to a temp vault and `BOB_DIR` to another temp dir. Also audit the other `run_cycle_with_existing_lock_report` callers that accept `-b`/a vault override (task move, randomize, vault_rewrite, migrate_tasks, migrate_zorg) for the same mismatch.

issue.creation_reason: Found by bob-cli-c9.land while fixing the same wrong-vault pre-sync in -f overwrite; rename predates the epic and still syncs BOB_DIR while committing in the -b vault.

payload.description: bx would move rename onto vault_rewrite's shared lock/sync/commit transaction; fix the -b vs BOB_DIR pre-sync in whichever transaction rename ends up using
